content: आव्यध् €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To hit, pierce; see अनाविद्ध. .²2 To wound. .²3 To break or pierce through. .²4 To put on; निवस्स्वाऽऽविध्य च स्रजम् <ls>Bk. 20. 11</ls>. .²5 To shoot at, throw or cast towards. .²6 To throw away, cast off. .²7 To wave, brandish; आविद्धावेव दृश्येते <ls>Mb. 1. 226. 3</ls>; आविध्य शूलं तरसा <ls>Bhāg. 10. 59. 8</ls>. .²8 To pin on. .²9 To rouse, agitate, stir up. .²10 To drive away, expel; निर्बन्धमाविध्यति <ls>Mv. 5. 39</ls>.
